summary.en: The first person to be questioned is the cleaner, she confirms that she had cleaned Danji Rinzaki's room but did not find any code at that time, not to mention she also expresses her discomfort at having to clean the room because he always violated the smoking policy and was kicked out of several hotels that coincidentally had bombings, luckily this hotel owner is a fan of his so he is allowed to stay. In addition, she was also asked to bring humidifiers to both rooms because she heard that someone was coughing, this accidentally alerted Sera because Mary often coughed for some reason. The second person to be questioned is Kureishi, who says that he had left immediately after delivering Rinzaki's luggage and had not entered his room. Finally, Rinzaki, although somewhat uncomfortable, accepts the questioning. He says that he had seen the code on the table near the humidifier after checking in and wondered if it belonged to the bomber. Kisaki lies that it was not and asks to search the room, he initially refuses but after hearing that he will be responsible if the bomb explodes, he complies.
